reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 discusses creep in single-phase BCC alloys, not dual-phase FCC/BCC interfaces. E2 describes shear band formation and nano-twins at grain boundaries in a single-phase BCC HEA, not at FCC/BCC phase boundaries. E3 only provides a general creep equation and does not address interfaces, pile-up, or nano-twinning. No evidence supports the claimed interfacial mechanisms or the comparative prediction.
